findings.finding: In bootstrap v4 lines 430-546, the first protected startup try persists science release at line 481 and then waits for acceptance, but its line-491 except Exception does not catch KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit. Reviewer fault injection observed release_persisted=true, post_release_unresolved=false, and the controller child still live.

The terminal-success writer only prechecks for an unresolved artifact, while the unresolved writer does not check for terminal success. A bootstrap BaseException path can therefore leave both controller_terminal_success=true and post_release_unresolved=true. Per-file hard-link create-if-absent prevents overwrite of one file but does not provide cross-terminal mutual exclusion.
The focused tests did not cover the post-release pre-acceptance BaseException window or the cross-terminal terminal-success versus unresolved race.
